parsed.title: The even-by-even hook Conway-pair conjecture
parsed.statement: A partition is a Young diagram, and its **Conway pair** is the pair of game-theoretic invariants used in the Conway–Gurvich–Ho classification. An **even-by-even hook** is a hook with an even number of rows and an even number of columns. **Even-by-even hook conjecture.** A partition $\lambda$ has Conway pair $(0,1)$ if and only if $\lambda$ is an even-by-even hook. Conway pairs $(0,1)$ and $(1,0)$ play an important role in the classification scheme; the source leaves this characterization as a conjecture.
parsed.source_name: Ina Bašić, Eric Gottlieb and Matjaž Krnc, “CRIM: A Natural Game on Integer Partitions”, arXiv:2606.16828 (2026).
